messages:
Priya (Product): Quick post-all-hands: customers asked for a short summary on BYOK rotations, HSM support, DSAR ownership, and ISO evidence timing. Can we capture concise answers here?
Leah (Head of Security): Sure. BYOK: supported for Dedicated & Private. We recommend 90-day rotations; we won't force rewrap. There's an opt-in managed rotation add-on.
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSMs: on-prem HSMs use a KMIP connector agent. GA target = end of Q3 pending pilot integrations and security sign-off.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: Hosted API = we retain request metadata by default; payloads ephemeral unless customer opts in. Private/Dedicated = customer owns data and is responsible for DSARs; Redwood provides export tooling and contract-bound assistance.
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence roadmap (soft): June - export templates; August - self-serve evidence bundles; Sept - auditor-access toggles. We'll publish details in compliance docs.
Priya (Product): Can we offer immutable audit replicas?
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can replicate audit logs to customer buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning. WORM/immutability depends on storage provider features; we'll document recommended configs.
Leah (Head of Security): Action items: Leah -> BYOK FAQ + DSAR ownership paragraph. Kai -> HSM pilot checklist & signup. Anya -> ISO evidence timeline + example exports.
ops-bot: Created SEC-901 "BYOK FAQ & DSAR policy", SEC-902 "HSM pilot checklist", SEC-903 "ISO evidence automation".
Priya (Product): Thanks all. I'll bundle the drafts into a customer-facing FAQ once they're published.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing loop. For NDA-level architecture requests, route via Legal.
